title: Paddies from the door, probably Rosethorn 007, on the run to the mountain
description: Through a helicopter door in flight: dry harvested paddies divided by dike lines run to a tree line, with a small pale building in the middle distance; inside the frame edge the muzzle of a rifle angles up beside a strap. "This is a rice paddies in the background. We took off from Ton Suhn Nhut to Nui Ba Den. We take off low for 10-15 miles and then we go up about 3000 to 5000 feet. The distance was about 70 miles. This would be in Rosethorn 007"
researchNotes: Two comments of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0071-c18307905.json, -c18307913.json). The flight profile and distance are recorded on the helicopter-travel timeline entry; Tân Sơn Nhứt to Núi Bà Đen is about 53 statute miles direct, so his 'about 70' is a loose but reasonable memory of a run he flew often. The second comment tells of a shoot-down with PFC Jones (ledger #34, data/people/pfc-jones.json) and ends 'That is what PFC Jones was looking at in the picture.' Jones is not in this frame; at VN-0012 he says Jones is looking at a bullet hole in the rotor, so 'the picture' most likely means VN-0012 (an inference from the two comments, recorded 2026-09-14; the audit of that day raised it). The description no longer attaches the event to this frame, and the frame is not cataloged as a picture of the incident. Rosethorn 007 has now been named on its own four times. 2026-09-14: a person link on the first comment that its words do not support was removed (research/photos/held-from-records-2026-09-14.md, VN-0016).
